description: This file defines the interface 'TaxClassDao' which extends a generic DAO interface. It provides methods for retrieving 'TaxClass' objects based on store and code identifiers within the sales manager tax module.

classes.name: TaxClassDao
classes.description: An interface extending the generic DAO for 'TaxClass' entities, providing methods to retrieve tax classes by store and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of 'TaxClass' objects associated with the specified merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a 'TaxClass' by its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a 'TaxClass' by its unique code within a specific merchant store context.
